clients.title: Built for ambitious companies, stores & services

services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: Everything you need to look professional and grow online — under one roof.

web.title: Web & Platform Development
web.description: Fast, responsive websites and custom platforms built with modern tech. Landing pages, e-commerce stores, dashboards and web apps that work flawlessly on every device.

brand.title: Brand Identity & Signature
brand.description: Logos, visual identity and brand signatures that make you instantly recognizable. We craft the personality that sets your business apart from the crowd.

design.title: Graphic & Visual Design
design.description: Flyers, banners, social media posts and print-ready visuals. Clean, eye-catching designs that communicate your message and turn viewers into customers.

marketing.title: Digital Marketing
marketing.description: Social media strategy, content and campaigns that get you noticed. We help your brand reach the right audience and grow a real following.

process.title: How We Work
process.subtitle: A simple, transparent process — from idea to launch.
process.step1_desc: We listen to your goals, study your market and define exactly what success looks like.
process.step2_desc: We craft the identity, layout and visuals — sharing previews until it feels right.
process.step3_desc: Our developers turn the design into a fast, secure and responsive product.
process.step4_desc: We ship it, fine-tune the details and support you as you grow.

why.title: Why Choose VOLTIX
why.subtitle: A young, hungry team that treats your project like our own.
why.point1_desc: Every pixel has a purpose. We design to impress and to convert.
why.point2_desc: We build with the latest, fastest tools — no outdated templates.
why.point3_desc: Developers, designers and marketers working together for you.
why.point4_desc: Clear pricing, honest timelines and constant communication.

team.title: Meet the Team
team.subtitle: Seven specialists, one mission: make your brand shine.

about.title: We are VOLTIX
about.subtitle: A creative agency born from a team of university students with a shared obsession for great design and clean code.
about.description: VOLTIX started as a group of seven friends at university who wanted to do more than study — we wanted to build. Today we craft websites, platforms and visual identities for companies, stores and services. We combine development, design, marketing and solid management into one tight-knit studio.
about.mission: To give every business — big or small — a digital presence they can be proud of. Beautiful design, powerful technology, and a brand that people remember.
about.vision: To grow from a student studio into a leading creative agency — building products, owning technologies and solving real problems at scale.
